recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, chaotic collage featuring a vibrant neon yellow and magenta textured background, overlaid with black-and-white high-contrast photography, hand-drawn punk doodles, and heavy, distressed typography that mimics cut-and-paste zine culture.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white figures against hyper-saturated neon backgrounds
Juxtaposition of clean vector-like doodles with gritty, distressed textures
Layered depth created by overlapping paper-cutout effects and ink splatters
coreInvariants: Triadic color scheme of neon yellow, magenta, and electric green
Heavy use of black ink splatters and spray-paint textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central typographic block dominates the middle ground; photographic figures are scaled down at the bottom; a profile face is cropped large on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text blocks, moves down through the central large lettering, and exits through the screaming profile on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with 'horror vacui' tendencies, filled with graffiti and splatters.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the background vs. zero saturation (pure black/white) in the foreground elements.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular baseline and varying glyph heights
Integration of icons (hearts, crowns) into letterforms
White paper-cutout backing for legibility against busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: O replaced with heart/safety pin icon
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking different weights of distressed sans-serifs to create a ransom-note effect.

preserve: The white 'torn paper' background behind the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, tactile feel of the central text.
Fits the DIY punk aesthetic for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gritty, textured background using a mix of neon yellow and magenta spray paint effects. Add black ink splatters and purple graffiti tags. Include a high-contrast black and white profile of a person with electric green mohawk hair on the right side, and a small group of people sitting at the bottom in high-contrast B&W.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, distressed, hand-drawn black lettering in the center. Place a white 'torn paper' shape behind the letters. Add small punk icons like a heart with a safety pin and a crown. Place two black rectangular strips with white distressed text at the top.

verificationChecks: Do the photographic elements have a high-contrast, xeroxed look?
Is the typography sufficiently distressed and 'messy'?
Are there visible ink splatters and paper-tear edges?

mustAchieve: Clear separation between neon background and B&W foreground

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no smooth gradients are present; everything should be textured.
Check that the green accent color is used sparingly but effectively.
Verify the 'ransom note' feel of the top text blocks.
Confirm the central text has a white 'cutout' border.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Neon Triadic Background] + [High-Contrast B&W Photography] + [Distressed Illustrated Typography] + [Punk Doodles] to create a DIY zine aesthetic.
